title: Conditions on an Instalment Required in Advance when a Withdrawn Building Automation Service Plan Is Settled
content:
# Conditions on an Instalment Required in Advance when a Withdrawn Building Automation Service Plan Is Settled

**Condition 1.** Where the plan's remote access and monitoring have stood withdrawn since the day recorded on the plan and the charges required now are at least twice the tier's instalment, a whole instalment is required in advance.

**Condition 2.** Where the plan's remote access and monitoring have stood withdrawn since the day recorded on the plan and the charges required now are at least one instalment and less than twice the instalment, half an instalment is required in advance.

**Condition 3.** In every other case no instalment is required in advance.

| Remote access and monitoring standing withdrawn since the day recorded on the plan | Charges required now, against the tier's instalment | Share of the instalment required in advance |
|---|---|---|
| yes | at least twice it | 1 whole instalment |
| yes | at least one and less than twice it | 0.5 of an instalment |
| yes | less than one instalment | none |
| no | any | none |

## Boundary reading

Charges required now of exactly one instalment fall under Condition 2, the boundary being at least one instalment; charges of exactly twice the instalment fall under Condition 1, the boundary being at least twice it. A plan under the Building Automation Service Plans whose remote access and monitoring are not standing withdrawn carries no advance instalment whatever the charges required now.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A plan whose tier's instalment is 1950.00 USD, standing withdrawn since the day recorded on it, with charges required now of 4100.00 USD: since 4100.00 USD is at least twice 1950.00 USD, a whole instalment, that is 1950.00 USD, is required in advance. With charges required now of 2600.00 USD, half an instalment, that is 975.00 USD, would be required in advance.
